title: Infosys HackWithInfy 2027
summary: Infosys's national coding contest: two online coding rounds, then a grand finale, with pre-placement interview tracks.
eligibility: Indian residents 18+ in BE/BTech, ME/MTech, dual degree, MS (Research), MCA or 5-year MSc programmes, from the specified graduating batch.

prize.description: Cash prizes at the grand finale (amounts not stated in the published terms) plus PPI and job-offer tracks.

notes: The 2026 edition opened registrations on 6 February 2026 for the class of 2027.
